steps.text: D3DMetal gets past the DXMT crash (a shared texture DXMT cannot create, highball#95) and, unlike DXVK, lights the scenes: the maintainer ran the free demo on an M1 Pro on 2026-09-17 through the menus, character creation and the spawn picker, all with lit 3D backdrops at 45 to 57 fps fullscreen on the built-in display. The reporter found DXVK far too dark to play. Gameplay past the spawn is not measured here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: On DXMT the game crashes at start with "Direct3DDevice->CreateTexture2D failed with error E_FAIL", MiscFlags 0x2 (reported on an M5 Pro)
knownIssues.cause: reported crash text: Unreal asks for a texture shared between processes and DXMT does not support shared resources

knownIssues.symptom: On DXVK the menu draws but the game itself is very dark, characters and terrain barely visible (reported on an M5 Pro)
knownIssues.cause: not measured, a lighting or shader problem on the DXVK path
knownIssues.fix: none verified yet, D3DMetal is the next mode to try, the row is updated when the reporter answers
